canonical_thesis: Independent Witness BC initiative: dignity first; community accountability and evidence-led support for vulnerable people and workers. Web3 builder activity is a separate optional lane.
supersedes: All Witness-specific pre-Web3 preservation, institutional distribution, corporate consultancy and Stripe checkout instructions
p0: Evidence-labelled case briefs and press discovery
outbound_mail: Only Witness-owned sender and actual sent receipts for outbound letters; private community intake is the dedicated Witness BC API, not mailto-only.
revenue_and_economy: Community native economics, optional funded missions and verified crypto payments when actually supported and authorized; no fabricated cash or token.
live_status_rule: Pilot blueprint is not an officially founder-published community; member and XP records require real authenticated users.
production_rule: Publish 24 allowlisted pages, 5 static assets and separate private Dignity Stream API endpoints, excluding legacy institutional consultancy and checkout.
rights: No implied venture equity, company IP rights, or profit share.
owner_signature_authority: Must be Witness-specific and explicitly authorized for any outbound communication. Never reuse another venture's account solely because it is connected.
future_agents: Latest Founder directive 2026-11-23 supersedes older Web3-only website scope. Witness BC dignity and community protection are primary.

visual_identity.baseline: Witness AI before 2026-11-17 Web3 UI replacement; original Witness light/dark system.
identity: policy decision workbench as hero visual
navy/slate surfaces and restrained cyan-blue accent
prohibited: removing original brand without explicit founder permission
visual_identity.rule: Web3 changes strategy, content, users, economy and flows; it does NOT authorize changing original Witness UI, core brand or color without an explicit separate Founder request.
visual_identity.acceptance: Playwright tests original light Inter theme, slate-blue primary, hex mark, workbench, light-dark switch, and 320/390/1440 widths.

founder_directive_2026_11_23: Dignity and vulnerable people are the core of Witness BC. Create public case tracking and journalist-friendly routes, while distinguishing reported accounts from verified findings. Persistent private intake, receipt tracking, operator lifecycle and referenced issue atlas take precedence over mailto-only intake.
legal_and_editorial_status: Independent initiative. Not a government human rights tribunal, legal practice, or officially accredited media regulator.
intake: Private server-side Blob storage, authenticated operator and reporter receipt lookup; never autopublish unverified submissions.
public_research_policy: Three sourced system briefs are third-party official research, not accepted Witness complaint reports or verified Witness outcomes.
dignity_stream: Nine-stage evidence-labelled community concern workflow: private record, priority and routing, owner and next action, internal target date, actual organization correspondence, verified outcome. No accusation against identified employees or unverified systemic legal finding.
